title: Box Clusters
description: Cluster 3D boxes by proximity using minimum spanning tree.
writeup:
## Approach

Boxes in 3D space need to be grouped by proximity. Compute all pairwise Euclidean distances and sort them (Kruskal’s algorithm approach).

## Part 1

Process the 1000 shortest edges using Union-Find. After 1000 edges, find the three largest connected components and multiply their sizes.

## Part 2

Continue adding edges until all boxes form a single connected component. The answer involves the last edge that completes the spanning tree — specifically the product of the x-coordinates of the two boxes it connects.

Union-Find with path compression and union by rank makes this efficient even for many boxes.
